title: Detailed teddy bear
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='20' r='11' fill='#C98A4B'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='20' r='6' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='20' r='11' fill='#C98A4B'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='20' r='6' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='26' ry='23' fill='#D99A55'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='43' rx='13' ry='10' fill='#F0C48A'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='30' r='4' fill='#2B1B3D'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='30' r='4' fill='#2B1B3D'/>
  <circle cx='41.5' cy='28.5' r='1.3' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='61.5' cy='28.5' r='1.3' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='39' rx='6' ry='4.5' fill='#3A2355'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='37.5' rx='1.6' ry='1.1' fill='#B8A6D9'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 43.5 Q50 47 46 48' stroke='#7A4A1E' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 43.5 Q50 47 54 48' stroke='#7A4A1E' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='24' ry='23' fill='#D99A55'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='73' rx='13' ry='14' fill='#F0C48A'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='62' rx='9' ry='15' fill='#C98A4B' transform='rotate(20 24 62)'/>
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='62' rx='9' ry='15' fill='#C98A4B' transform='rotate(-20 76 62)'/>
  <!-- paw pads on arms -->
  <ellipse cx='19' cy='74' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#F0C48A'/>
  <ellipse cx='81' cy='74' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#F0C48A'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='90' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#C98A4B'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='90' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#C98A4B'/>
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='90' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#F0C48A'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='90' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#F0C48A'/>
  <!-- stitched seam on belly -->
  <path d='M50 59 L50 87' stroke='#B87A3E' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-dasharray='3 3'/>
  <!-- bow tie -->
  <path d='M42 53 L50 57 L50 49 Z' fill='#E05A6E'/>
  <path d='M58 53 L50 57 L50 49 Z' fill='#E05A6E'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='53' r='2.5' fill='#FFB3BE'/>
</svg>
